tools.name: facturalia_get_invoice_status
tools.description: Get the sent and paid status of one invoice by its number. Facturalia API: GET /invoices/status/?number=.

tools.name: facturalia_get_credit_note_status
tools.description: Get the paid status of one credit note by its number. Facturalia API: GET /creditnotes/status/?number=.

tools.name: facturalia_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a sales invoice in the live Facturalia account from customer and line data. It creates a real invoice that counts toward the account's invoices; it is not sent by e-mail (autosend is not offered). Send external_id so a retry does not create a second invoice. Facturalia API: POST /invoices/.

tools.name: facturalia_create_credit_note
tools.description: Create a credit note in the live Facturalia account from customer and line data. It creates a real document; it is not sent by e-mail (autosend is not offered). Send external_id so a retry does not create a second credit note. Facturalia API: POST /creditnotes/.
